Samira Cole: Heads-up 1: need a compact onboarding checklist for ISV tooling connectors (LangChain/LlamaIndex + gateways/orchestrators) that spans marketplace listing, HW compatibility, CI checks, and announcement coordination. Quick volunteers?
Tobias Ng: I take CI + smoke test templates. aim to add GH Actions scaffold.
Meera Shah: I own marketplace metadata and the quickstart example (streaming + tool-calls).
Victor Park: I handle HW/quantization validation and perf baselines. will capture mem profiles.
Marin Boyd: I draft partner announcement cadence and co-marketing items. prefer soft-launch mid-June.
Samira Cole: Nice. Minimal required items for playbook: owners, checklist, CI job, security gates, sample app, and embargo timeline.
Tobias Ng: CI smoke items: end-to-end call via orchestrator, streaming hook, fallback to hosted model, and basic perf smoke (p95).
Meera Shah: Marketplace fields: name, short/long desc, quickstart link, repo, supported infra, logo, regions, contact, security compliance note.
Victor Park: HW targets: H100/A100 and one 48GB card for smaller partners. Tests: 8k chat, 16k summarization, quantized accuracy vs fp16.
Marin Boyd: Announcement plan: blog + product update + partner webinar. I'll coordinate quotes and demo script.
Oncall Bot: Created playbook issue: https://git.internal/rw/issues/8770 :white_check_mark:
Samira Cole: Action recap: Tobias - CI template (4d), Meera - marketplace + quickstart (4d), Victor - HW numbers (7d), Marin - announcement draft (10d). Kickoff sync tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Tobias Ng: ack
Meera Shah: ack
Victor Park: ack
Marin Boyd: ack
Samira Cole: If partners ready, we can target mid-June soft launch. Ping me or @Marin if blocked. :rocket:
